title: JE2 source-backed solubility evidence profile
scientific_question: What is the bounded molecular-validity, frozen-ESOL applicability-domain, and immutable AqSolDB measured-source coverage profile of the MOLDISC-007-selected JE2 crystallographic seed before any new analog generation or docking?

parent_program.selection_role: operational fallback seed from previously observed evidence

followup_gate.generation_source_ready_if: chemistry PASS and nearest AqSolDB Tanimoto >= 0.4
followup_gate.reason_esol_not_required: MOLDISC-004 demonstrated that IN_DOMAIN status is not an absolute calibration guarantee; ESOL status is recorded independently.

interpretation_boundaries: MOLDISC-008 characterizes the selected JE2 seed and performs no candidate generation or docking.
Frozen ESOL output is E1_ML and is not an experimental solubility measurement.
IN_DOMAIN status indicates representation support under the frozen ESOL applicability rule; it does not establish calibration for JE2.
AqSolDB nearest-neighbor measurements are contextual measured-source evidence and are not transferred as JE2 experimental measurements unless an exact canonical-structure match is found.
Structural similarity does not establish shared biological mechanism, affinity, potency or efficacy.
A follow-up generation-ready state only means the source seed passed chemistry and retained the predeclared measured-source structural-coverage boundary.
No safety, synthesizability, metabolism, efficacy or clinical claim is supported.
